speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fish, it being Friday. Sit. The loaf has not grown since Wednesday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A finger short of the notch, sir. I did not buy another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going out to mend a loaf. Fair Em is at the Keys. I am not in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, fish or flesh, and I am not sending a girl across the town to look at a playbill. You have a desk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The desk has the afternoon. There is no rehearsal tomorrow until nine. I am not starting one in your kitchen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the letter gone, sir? I have not seen the string since yesterday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gone yesterday. Hobbins has it. You need not look for it on the desk.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat the fish, and leave the desk until you mean to use it. Gib has already tried the bones, and Gib may not have them.
